choices.content: The number of items in that category
How the number of items changes over time
The percentage of the total in that category

question.prompt: A bar chart has one bar for each category, and its vertical axis shows the number of items. What does the height of each bar directly show?

solutions.explanation: On this bar chart, the vertical axis gives item counts, so each bar height shows the number of items in its category. Thus A is correct.
solutions.title: Interpret the bar height
